card.summary: High-quality native-1024 base with strong prompt adherence and composition; the standard general-purpose foundation.
card.pick_when: Default for general/photoreal natural-language requests without an anime-tag workflow.

prompt.guidance: Concise descriptive prompts; quality-booster spam not needed.
prompt.example: cinematic photo of a red fox in a snowy forest at golden hour, shallow depth of field, 85mm, highly detailed
prompt.overview: Dual-CLIP model, 1024 native: short natural phrases or comma-separated descriptor tags; richer than SD1.x but still keyword-friendly.
prompt.instructions: Generate at 1024x1024 (native -- 512 hurts SDXL). Both short natural phrases and comma-separated descriptor/quality tag stacks work. Lead with the subject; add quality/style descriptors. No documented default CFG (diffusers default 7.5). Same family limits: no perfectly reliable legible text, weak spatial composition, imperfect faces. Negative prompts are supported and widely used for quality/anatomy.
do: Use short natural phrases or comma-separated descriptor tags
Lead with the subject; include quality/style descriptors
examples: Astronaut in a jungle, cold color palette, muted colors, detailed, 8k
A majestic lion jumping from a big stone at night
An astronaut riding a green horse
prompt.negative_guidance: Helpful (not documented as required). Typical: 'blurry, lowres, bad anatomy, extra fingers, watermark, text, jpeg artifacts'.

negative.note: Helpful but less critical than SD1.5.

speed.measured_note: ~24s for the first image at default settings (1024x1024, 30 steps, cold: includes model load); repeats with the same model are faster.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in a sentence or two, like you'd tell ChatGPT. More detail usually looks better.
